svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: One witness reaches a parabola, not a ball
svg.text: directrix: Σ pushed to the far side by d₀
v₁ certified by v₀ ⟺ d₀ + ε > |v₁−v₀|
Focus at v₀ itself; vertex ON Σ at P₀.
So one witness reaches zero depth —
but at exactly one tangential offset.
The ball (blue) is strictly inside it.
2. A witness's reach is a parabola with focus at the witness
